ui_bugs.issue: At 390x844 the modal's two action buttons (export-button, confirm-remove-button) are below the fold; Playwright auto-scroll-into-view failed inside the bottom-sheet ScrollView (needed JS scrollIntoView). Elderly users may not discover the buttons.

integration_issues.flow: App refresh / reload wipes usage stats and export tracking
integration_issues.issue: index.tsx:186-188 — refresh() builds next = { residents, capsules } WITHOUT usage and exports, then writeLocalState(next) persists it. Every successful server sync resets usage counters to 0 and erases the exports map (the removal gate). Consequence: stats screen loses all accumulated time after reload; a user who exported then reloaded must re-export before removal (fail-safe direction but loses the audit trail).

rca_of_issue: Bug: usage stats and export tracking reset on every app refresh. Reproduction: record a capsule / export a resident (export-done appears), reload the web preview, reopen stats or the remove modal — stats show 0 s and 'Export réalisé le' is gone (removal blocked again). Root cause: refresh() in app/index.tsx constructs next = { residents: mergeResidents(...), capsules: local.capsules } and persists it via writeLocalState(next); the object lacks usage and exports keys, so readLocalState falls back to DEFAULT_STATE for both on the next read. Mitigation: spread the local state first ({ ...local, residents: mergeResidents(...) }) or explicitly carry usage/exports into next.
